# Season 16: Ticket prices for rewards compared

![Season 16: Ticket prices for rewards compared](/uploads/313_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Now that we know how the new season will work from March 26th, 2024 after the Atlantic City - America's Playground update, further interesting details have become known. Bethesda briefly showed off almost all aspects of the new season in their Dev Dive video, so we can now get an idea of ​​the actual ticket prices for the rewards.

## Ticket prices calculated in table

I have now calculated all the prices of the well-known sites and compared them in a table. Pages 6, 11 and 12 were missing. However, the prices can also be derived from the preceding and following pages. Overall, any fears that you won't be able to finish the board or the season with rank are unfounded. Basically it comes down to the same thing as before. Only this time we can choose our favorite rewards more easily. Another advantage is that there are still rewards between ranks 100-150, and only from 150 onwards the well-known repeating consumables.

![Season 16: Ticket Price Comparison](/uploads/season16-ticket-price-table-.jpg) 

The Fallout 1st rewards are included in the price difference. So if you play without 1st and just redeem the normal rewards, you will get along very well with your tickets.
